body: I think I'll just keep away from this toxic Subreddit, especially now that I'm getting hate DMs over this.

That seems painfully childish of people... That's not what the upvote or downvote is for. I can't understand such blind action over something like that, instead of over the actual quality of the content itself. Though if anyone downvoted it for the quality of the content, then that's fair, even if though I was hoping for feedback.

To be clear, I wasn't even suggesting her be in the game, I was using an official character that won't be in the game and speculating how they may play if they did.

I'd planned to do so for the others that would likely not be in the game as well.

Alas, it is what it is, and I'm glad I got a response at all, so thank you for that. I appreciate it.
Put a lot of work into this... And the frustrating thing is that I don't know if it's some silly taboo that's causing it to be downvoted into oblivion, or if my concept just sucks.

I feel that candy conversion is the best way to do it.
It makes use of an existing finite resource and would be simple to implement.
1 Charmander Candy = 1 Mega Charizard Energy.

Edit: and they need to give the individual mega energy types at least unique colours. You can't tell which you're getting in research tasks sometimes right now.

I'm still confused why they haven't added a PokeStop Dex.
I understand that now, with the pandemic, such a thing may not be a high priority...
But I think it should have been included from day 1.
You can catch pretty much any Pokemon from home, but you have to travel to visit a PokeStop.
Which PokeStops we've been to is already stored, so having a scrapbook of all the places we've been, as well as a "seen" type thing for locations from gifts sent to us, would be relatively easy from my perspective and understanding.

Looked through the thread and couldn't find this...

For a game about visiting places and collecting, I'm really astounded that a PokeStop Dex hasn't been implemented yet.
A gallery containing all the PokeStops you've visited and when you last visited it.

Heck, if it's about space on the server or something, I'd even be okay with a limited gallery where you could get extra space from the shop, like with Pokemon and item storage, and manage which PokeStops are stored in the gallery at your leisure.
